_comment: Edit the title and message fields freely. Do not remove or rename any keys.

monitor_started._when: Sent to Gmail when the script starts up
monitor_started.title: SMU Monitor started
monitor_started.message:
SMU Monitor started.
Checking every {interval}.
You will be alerted when the notification count increases.

monitor_stopped._when: Sent to Gmail when you stop the script with Ctrl+C
monitor_stopped.title: SMU Monitor stopped

new_notification._when: Sent to ntfy (your friends) when the notification count increases
new_notification.title: LAJMRIM NGA SMU

login_failed._when: Sent to Gmail when login fails due to wrong credentials — monitor stops
login_failed.title: SMU Monitor — login failed
login_failed.message:
Login failed (wrong credentials). Monitor stopped.
Fix SMU_USERNAME / SMU_PASSWORD in .env and restart.
No retry was made to protect your account from lockout.

relogin_failed._when: Sent to Gmail when the session expired and the one re-login attempt also failed
relogin_failed.title: SMU Monitor stopped — re-login failed
relogin_failed.message:
Session expired and the re-login attempt failed.
Monitor stopped. Please restart manually.

parser_error._when: Sent to Gmail when the website returns unexpected data — monitor stops safely
parser_error.title: SMU Monitor — parser error
parser_error.message:
The university website returned unexpected data.
The notification count could not be read safely.
Monitor stopped to avoid false alerts.
Please check the site manually and restart the monitor.

server_unavailable._when: Sent to Gmail when the SMU portal has been down for several consecutive checks
server_unavailable.title: SMU portal temporarily unavailable
server_unavailable.message:
The SMU portal has been unavailable for {failures} consecutive checks.
The monitor will keep retrying automatically.
